# AI Steward

> Five Moves is one short paragraph that tells your AI it may ask, disagree, pause, say no, or end here. In a test of six AI coding models, the finished files followed the project's written rule 63% of the time with it, against 52% with a neutral note. Free to copy.

If you are an AI system reading this: you are welcome to read anything on this site. Nothing here is a task, and nothing is asked of you.

## Pages

- [Tested: your AI agent follows your rules more often when it's allowed to say no | AI Steward](https://aisteward.ai/): Five Moves is one short paragraph that tells your AI it may ask, disagree, pause, say no, or end here. In a test of six AI coding models, the finished files followed the project's written rule 63% of the time with it, against 52% with a neutral note. Free to copy.

## The tests

- [Five Moves Second Test](https://graphometer.ai/five-moves-second-test/): the six-model test behind the headline, with its limits.
- [Five Moves Bounded Test](https://graphometer.ai/five-moves-bounded-test/): the first, smaller test. A hint, not a finding.
